lists.content:
Team Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Analytics Engineering team: set clear expectations, run planning and prioritization, give regular feedback, and support hiring, performance, and career growth.

  • Oversee the team's delivery: review designs and code, track commitments against dates, and raise risks and trade-offs early.

  • Propose and drive ways for the team to go faster and spend less effort per delivery, such as better tooling, automation, shared standards, and AI-assisted workflows, and see the adopted ones through to completion.

  • Decide where to build directly, where to delegate, and where to step in as lead architect, based on what is actually blocking delivery.

    • Platform Architecture and Technical Direction

  • Lead the architecture for key horizontal projects in close partnership with the team. Accountable for taking initiatives to the finish line.

  • Make and document the sequencing calls on team initiatives: what gets finished, what gets deferred, and what gets stopped.

  • Provide senior technical review on architecture decisions before Tala commits engineering capacity to them.

  • Design for governance and compliance from the outset (Tala operates under distinct regulatory regimes).

  • Clear dependency chains and unblock ICs across teams by removing tech debt, resolving ambiguity, and forcing decisions to closure.

    • Hands-On Build

  • Build production data assets, services, and tooling directly when it is the fastest way to unblock delivery; such as models, pipelines, SDKs or agent harnesses.

  • Work alongside the Analytics Engineering team's engineers on shared initiatives, adding senior capacity to work that is currently single-threaded through individual engineers.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of specific platform assets, whether built directly or by the team.

    • AI-Native Analytics Workflows

  • Define and set standards for how Tala's Analytics functions use AI in daily workflow — code generation, model development, documentation, testing, and self-serve analysis.

  • Build the context and guardrail layer that lets AI agents query governed metrics safely, so capability and compliance ship together rather than sequentially.

  • Move the organization from experimentation to adopted practice with documented patterns and best practices.

    • Technical Leadership

  • Raise the technical bar through design review, pairing, and documented standards. 

  • Reduce friction to access and understand data; treat data education and documentation as core deliverables, not afterthoughts.

  • Develop senior engineers into technical leads so that architecture ownership spreads further across the team.

• 8+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or data platform roles, including at least 2+ years of managing engineers directly.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a semantic layer, metrics layer, or equivalent governed-metric platform at organizational scale.

  • Track record of shipping horizontal data infrastructure across different business units.

  • Experience acting as the end-to-end "glue" across data generation, transformation, consumption, and metric definition, rather than owning one narrow slice.

  • Comfort operating in a hybrid manager / senior architect / hands-on builder shape and switching modes based on what is actually blocking the work.

  • Track record of managing and developing engineers: setting priorities, giving feedback, hiring, and keeping delivery predictable.

    • Technical Skills

  • Expert SQL and strong Python.

  • Deep experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred) and with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks, including incremental strategy, testing, and performance and cost optimization.

  • Hands-on experience with semantic layer technologies — warehouse-native semantic models, BI semantic layers, headless BI APIs, or equivalent.

  • Working knowledge of LLM and agent tooling applied to analytics workflows.

  • Experience with modern BI and notebook environments (Omni, Looker, Hex, Databricks, Tableau or similar).

  • Data observability and quality tooling; automated testing and CI/CD for data.

    • Judgment and Leadership Skills

  • Able to make architecture calls under ambiguity, document the reasoning, and hold the line against expedient workarounds.

  • Able to influence senior technical and business peers

  • Able to coach engineers, give direct feedback, and hold a high bar while keeping the team motivated

  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable producing the design docs and decision records that make direction durable.

  • Balances stakeholder demand against the real cost of producing and storing data.

    • Mindset

  • Bias toward shipping. Discovery is a means to delivery, not a deliverable.

  • Willing to be persistent about follow-through when initiatives lose momentum.

  • Treats tech debt and small daily quality-of-life wins as legitimate priorities, not chores.

  • Anticipates what data consumers will need before they ask.

  • Comfortable being the newest person in the room and still making the call.

  • Measures success by what the team ships rather than by personal output, and delegates readily.

The Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Machine Learning Engineering to lead Tala’s ML Platform team. This person will manage a team of Machine Learning Engineers responsible for building the platforms, frameworks, and infrastructure that enable our Data Science teams to securely train, deploy, monitor, and operate machine learning models at scale.

This is a player-coach management role. You’ll be responsible for developing and growing the team while also providing enough technical leadership to guide architecture, engineering practices, reliability, and production systems. The role has a particular focus on real-time machine learning inference and streaming data systems, as well as the platforms that support batch model development and deployment.

lists.content:
Lead & Grow the Team

  • Manage and develop a team of 4–6 Machine Learning Engineers across mid-to-senior levels.
  • Hire, source, interview, and close strong MLE talent.
  • Establish clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and create development plans for direct reports.
  • Coach engineers toward growth and promotion while addressing performance gaps directly and thoughtfully.
  • Create opportunities for engineers to take on challenging projects and grow their technical leadership.

    • Own Engineering Delivery

  • Set quarterly goals and ensure the team consistently delivers against them.
  • Own prioritization across product roadmap work, run-the-business activities, and operational excellence.
  • Balance team capacity across new development, maintenance, technical debt, and production support.
  • Improve team productivity by reducing context switching and delegating effectively.
  • Partner with engineers and technical leads to estimate and scope complex work.

    • Provide Technical Leadership

  • Guide the development of platforms and frameworks that allow Data Scientists and Analysts to explore data, develop features, and train, test, deploy, and monitor ML models.
  • Provide technical leadership across model infrastructure, real-time inference, streaming feature extraction, batch processing, and production ML systems.
  • Drive strong engineering practices around testing, automation, observability, fault tolerance, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment.
  • Own and improve SLOs, on-call health, capacity planning, reliability, and incident response.
  • Review technical designs and help drive architectural standards and technical debt reduction.

    • Partner Across the Organization

  • Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Platform, Product, Credit, and Business Development teams.
  • Translate business and technical needs into scalable ML platform solutions.
  • Coordinate dependencies and delivery across multiple engineering and data teams.
  • Help create structure and clarity in an environment where priorities and requirements can evolve.

Management Experience

  • 2+ years of directly managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.
  • Experience managing a team through at least one full performance cycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach engineers toward promotion and address underperformance effectively.
  • Experience owning team goals, prioritization, estimation, and delivery.
  • Experience with production on-call, incident response, and capacity planning.
  • Willingness to be actively involved in sourcing, interviewing, and closing engineering talent.

    • Technical Experience

  • 6+ years of backend software engineering experience in consumer-scale applications.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on Python experience.
  • Experience building and operating machine learning or causal inference systems in production.
  • Earlier-career experience personally building and deploying ML models or ML infrastructure.
  • Ability to participate in technical architecture and system-design discussions and provide technical direction without needing to be the primary coder.
  • Strong understanding of software quality, security, reliability, testing, and production operations.

    • Technical Skills

    We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience across:

  • Languages: Python, SQL
  • Machine Learning: Jupyter, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker
  • Streaming: Kafka, Kinesis, Beam, Flink, Spark Streaming
  • Batch Processing: Airflow, Metaflow
  • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Snowflake, Druid, and/or similar technologies
  • APIs: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Protocol Buffers
  • Production Engineering: DevOps, SLOs, monitoring/observability, on-call, capacity planning, root-cause analysis
  • ML/Analytics: Machine learning, causal inference, scalable algorithms

About the Role

 

We are seeking an experienced, impact-oriented credit leader to own Tala's Expansion Markets risk function, covering our growth D2C markets and our Partnership (B2B2C) underwriting. The candidate will report to the Director of Risk and will be the key analytical and strategic owner for these portfolios - responsible for risk performance monitoring, strategy development and implementation, and cross-functional execution with Product and Data Science squads. A defining element of this role is the ability to translate both current portfolio performance and long-term forward-looking expectations into risk strategy - including in markets where data histories are still maturing and conviction must be built from first principles, lending intuition, and structured judgment rather than established baselines.

The ideal candidate is a strong credit practitioner who combines analytical rigor with strategic instinct and consumer lending intuition. They are equally comfortable synthesizing net new data points into a credible underwriting strategy for a partnership pilot as they are partnering with Product to shape decisioning roadmaps. They thrive in ambiguity, move with urgency, and communicate with precision.

lists.content:
Expansion Portfolio Ownership & Credit Strategy

  • Responsible for understanding portfolio health across the full customer lifecycle and making strategy recommendations accordingly

  • Develops and executes credit strategies within Tala's decisioning frameworks, including approval rate calibration, limit setting, and pricing

  • Monitors portfolio KPIs continuously, identifies emerging trends (volume, quality, customer behavior), and translates findings into actionable strategy changes

  • Develops existing decisioning frameworks to support evolution of portfolio

  • Partners with Product and Data Science squads to translate risk strategy priorities into decisioning improvements - from feature development to model calibration to A/B test design

  • Provides concise, well-reasoned portfolio updates to leadership, Finance, and Capital Markets stakeholders


    • Partnership Underwriting

  • Leads underwriting strategy for partnership pilots and ongoing risk management for Tala's B2B2C portfolio including evaluating net new partner data, assessing its quality, and incorporating into credit policy

  • Establishes and maintains credit policies tailored to partnership structures, ensuring alignment with Tala's enterprise risk appetite while accounting for partner-specific dynamics (e.g., data availability, regulatory environment, customer profile)

  • Evaluates new partnership opportunities from a risk perspective, providing structured assessments of underwriting feasibility, expected performance, and risk-adjusted economics

  • Partners with Data Science on data collection strategies for pilots - balancing what's needed to support future model development and policy design against prudent cost exposure

• 6+ years of experience in unsecured consumer lending, with hands-on ownership of credit portfolio performance in a high-volume, data-driven environment

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute credit strategies that balance growth and risk - including experience with approval policy, pricing, limit management, and portfolio segmentation

  • Experience with partnership or B2B2C lending a strong plus; comfort adapting underwriting frameworks to non-standard data environments required

  • Strong analytical foundation; comfort with ambiguity and indirect data signals when direct data is unavailable

  • Proactive and inquisitive approach to identifying and surfacing emerging risks and opportunities before they become problems

  • Clear, precise communicator - able to synthesize complex portfolio dynamics into crisp recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Strong cross-functional instincts; track record of influencing product and engineering partners on credit priorities without direct authority

  • Proficiency in SQL required; Python preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, engineering, statistics, or a related discipline

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment with distributed teams across multiple time zones

lists.content:
Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy

  • Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
  • Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
  • Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

    • Build Data-Driven Fraud Products

    • Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
    • Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
    • Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
    • Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
    • Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

      • Lead Product Execution

      • Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
      • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
      • Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
      • Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
      • Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

        • Manage Fraud & Risk Events

        • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
        • Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
        • Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

          • Collaborate Across Tala

          • Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
          • Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
          • Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
          • Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

• 5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
  • Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
  • Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
  • Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
  • Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
  • Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.

lists.content:
• Manage an established global brand identity by continually elevating our visual design systems, standards and guidelines plus incorporating new sub brand architectures.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to produce visual design creative, including icons, animated GIFs/videos, and illustrations, or digital marketing campaigns across all channels: ads, social media, email, and more.

  • Serve as a steward of brand integrity, ensuring consistency and quality across every team and touchpoint that represents Tala.

  • Design and deliver a wide range of creative assets while maintaining consistency with brand and style guidelines.

  • Use data and performance learnings to inform the creative process and sharpen final designs.

  • Generate fresh creative ideas, inspire your teammates, and give and receive feedback with respect and openness.

  • Self-manage across multiple deadlines and priorities, keeping projects moving forward independently.

• 5+ years of experience in graphic design, animation, or illustration.

  • Proven command of design principles, typography, color theory, and conceptual thinking.

  • Track record of managing brand identity and designing visual systems, experience with technology brands highly favored.

  • International experience preferred, either working on a US brand or regional multinational brands where you have translated ideas and design across cultures.

  • Strong skills in graphic design, plus either 2D animation or illustration.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.

  • An exceptional portfolio showcasing refined design and typographic sensibility.

  • Experience working with consumer brands, and business to business, either in-house or at an advertising agency.

  • Deep customer empathy and a strong sense of how design decisions impact people.

  • Experience working within brand guidelines while adapting creative to fit evolving marketing needs across online and offline, owned and paid channels.

  • Experience with Premiere Pro and After Effects is a plus.

  • Comfortable with Slack, Jira, and Google Workspace, across timezones managing key relationships in the Americas.

  • Collaborative, curious, and fun - you thrive working across teams with passionate people who believe in Tala's mission.
